#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare MVP experiment data for Prism Collapse Mixing.

Data layout (no overlap guaranteed):
- probe_set.jsonl: first 5000 stream samples with >= 256 tokens (truncated to 256)
- val_set.jsonl: next samples until 10M tokens accumulated
- real_pool.jsonl: subsequent samples until 400M tokens accumulated

All sourced from HuggingFaceFW/fineweb sample-10BT, train split, streaming mode.
"""

import json
import os
import sys
import time
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoTokenizer


def main():
    DATA_DIR = "/root/prism_collapse_mixing/data"
    os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    print("Loading Pythia tokenizer...", flush=True)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("EleutherAI/pythia-410m-deduped")

    PROBE_SIZE = 5000
    PROBE_TOKEN_LEN = 256
    VAL_TARGET_TOKENS = 10_000_000
    TRAIN_TARGET_TOKENS = 400_000_000

    print("Loading FineWeb sample-10BT (streaming)...", flush=True)
    ds = load_dataset(
        "HuggingFaceFW/fineweb",
        name="sample-10BT",
        split="train",
        streaming=True,
    )

    # === Phase 1: Probe set + Val set ===
    print("=== Phase 1: Probe set + Val set ===", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()

    probe_count = 0
    probe_total_tokens = 0
    val_count = 0
    val_total_tokens = 0
    stream_offset = 0

    probe_path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "probe_set.jsonl")
    val_path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "val_set.jsonl")

    probe_f = open(probe_path, "w")
    val_f = open(val_path, "w")

    for sample in ds:
        text = sample.get("text", "")
        if not text or not text.strip():
            stream_offset += 1
            continue

        tokens = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
        n_tokens = len(tokens)

        if probe_count < PROBE_SIZE:
            if n_tokens >= PROBE_TOKEN_LEN:
                trunc = tokens[:PROBE_TOKEN_LEN]
                probe_f.write(json.dumps({
                    "text": tokenizer.decode(trunc),
                    "token_count": PROBE_TOKEN_LEN,
                }) + "\n")
                probe_count += 1
                probe_total_tokens += PROBE_TOKEN_LEN
                if probe_count % 1000 == 0:
                    print(f"  Probe: {probe_count}/{PROBE_SIZE}", flush=True)
            elif val_total_tokens < VAL_TARGET_TOKENS:
                val_f.write(json.dumps({"text": text}) + "\n")
                val_count += 1
                val_total_tokens += n_tokens
        elif val_total_tokens < VAL_TARGET_TOKENS:
            val_f.write(json.dumps({"text": text}) + "\n")
            val_count += 1
            val_total_tokens += n_tokens
            if val_count % 5000 == 0:
                print(f"  Val: {val_count} samples, {val_total_tokens / 1e6:.1f}M tokens", flush=True)
        else:
            stream_offset += 1
            break

        stream_offset += 1

    probe_f.close()
    val_f.close()

    t1 = time.time()
    print(f"Probe: {probe_count} samples, {probe_total_tokens:,} tokens", flush=True)
    print(f"Val: {val_count} samples, {val_total_tokens:,} tokens ({val_total_tokens / 1e6:.1f}M)", flush=True)
    print(f"Stream offset for train: {stream_offset}", flush=True)
    print(f"Phase 1 time: {t1 - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)

    # === Phase 2: Train pool ===
    print(f"\n=== Phase 2: Train pool (~400M tokens, starting at offset {stream_offset}) ===", flush=True)

    ds2 = load_dataset(
        "HuggingFaceFW/fineweb",
        name="sample-10BT",
        split="train",
        streaming=True,
    )
    ds2 = ds2.skip(stream_offset)

    train_count = 0
    train_total_tokens = 0
    train_path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "real_pool.jsonl")

    with open(train_path, "w") as f:
        for sample in ds2:
            text = sample.get("text", "")
            if not text or not text.strip():
                continue

            tokens = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
            n_tokens = len(tokens)

            f.write(json.dumps({"text": text}) + "\n")
            train_count += 1
            train_total_tokens += n_tokens

            if train_count % 10000 == 0:
                elapsed = time.time() - t1
                rate = train_total_tokens / elapsed if elapsed > 0 else 0
                eta = (TRAIN_TARGET_TOKENS - train_total_tokens) / rate / 60 if rate > 0 else 0
                print(f"  Train: {train_count} samples, {train_total_tokens / 1e6:.1f}M tokens "
                      f"({rate / 1e6:.1f}M tok/s, ETA {eta:.0f}min)", flush=True)

            if train_total_tokens >= TRAIN_TARGET_TOKENS:
                break

    t2 = time.time()
    print(f"\nTrain pool: {train_count:,} samples, {train_total_tokens:,} tokens ({train_total_tokens / 1e6:.1f}M)", flush=True)
    print(f"Phase 2 time: {t2 - t1:.0f}s", flush=True)

    # === Summary ===
    print("\n" + "=" * 60, flush=True)
    print("SUMMARY", flush=True)
    print("=" * 60, flush=True)
    for name, cnt, tok in [
        ("probe_set", probe_count, probe_total_tokens),
        ("val_set", val_count, val_total_tokens),
        ("real_pool", train_count, train_total_tokens),
    ]:
        avg = tok / cnt if cnt > 0 else 0
        print(f"  {name:12s}: {cnt:>8,} samples, {tok:>13,} tokens (avg {avg:.0f} tok/sample)", flush=True)

    total_tok = probe_total_tokens + val_total_tokens + train_total_tokens
    total_cnt = probe_count + val_count + train_count
    print(f"  {'TOTAL':12s}: {total_cnt:>8,} samples, {total_tok:>13,} tokens", flush=True)
    print(f"\nTotal time: {t2 - t0:.0f}s ({(t2 - t0) / 60:.1f} min)", flush=True)
    print(f"No-overlap: probe+val from stream[0:{stream_offset}], train from stream[{stream_offset}:]", flush=True)

    for fname in ["probe_set.jsonl", "val_set.jsonl", "real_pool.jsonl"]:
        fpath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, fname)
        size_mb = os.path.getsize(fpath) / 1e6
        print(f"  {fname}: {size_mb:.1f} MB", flush=True)

    print("\nDONE", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
SCRIPT_EOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare MVP experiment data for Prism Collapse Mixing.

Uses HfFileSystem to directly locate parquet files, avoiding the slow
metadata loading of load_dataset with FineWeb's massive config.
"""

import json
import os
import sys
import time
from huggingface_hub import HfFileSystem
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoTokenizer


def find_parquet_files(fs):
    """Find parquet files in FineWeb repo."""
    repo = "datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb"
    
    # Try sample/10BT/ first
    for path in ["sample/10BT", "sample/10BT/train"]:
        try:
            items = fs.ls(f"{repo}/{path}", detail=False)
            parquet = sorted([f for f in items if f.endswith('.parquet')])
            if parquet:
                print(f"Found {len(parquet)} parquet files in {path}/", flush=True)
                return parquet
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Fall back: crawl data/ subdirectories
    print("Listing data/ subdirectories...", flush=True)
    subdirs = fs.ls(f"{repo}/data", detail=False)
    subdirs = sorted([d for d in subdirs if 'CC-MAIN' in d])
    print(f"Found {len(subdirs)} CC-MAIN directories", flush=True)

    parquet = []
    for sd in subdirs:
        try:
            files = fs.ls(sd, detail=False)
            pq = [f for f in files if f.endswith('.parquet')]
            parquet.extend(sorted(pq))
        except Exception:
            pass
        if len(parquet) >= 200:
            break

    print(f"Collected {len(parquet)} parquet files from data/", flush=True)
    return parquet


def main():
    DATA_DIR = "/root/prism_collapse_mixing/data"
    os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    print("Loading Pythia tokenizer...", flush=True)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("EleutherAI/pythia-410m-deduped")

    PROBE_SIZE = 5000
    PROBE_TOKEN_LEN = 256
    VAL_TARGET_TOKENS = 10_000_000
    TRAIN_TARGET_TOKENS = 400_000_000

    print("Locating FineWeb parquet files...", flush=True)
    fs = HfFileSystem()
    parquet_files = find_parquet_files(fs)

    if not parquet_files:
        print("ERROR: No parquet files found!", flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"First: {parquet_files[0]}", flush=True)
    print(f"Last:  {parquet_files[-1]}", flush=True)

    def to_hf_url(path):
        return f"hf://{path}"

    # Split: first 3 files for probe+val, rest for train (file-level no-overlap)
    PV_COUNT = 3
    pv_files = parquet_files[:PV_COUNT]
    train_files = parquet_files[PV_COUNT:]
    print(f"Probe+Val: {PV_COUNT} files, Train: {len(train_files)} files", flush=True)

    # === Phase 1: Probe + Val ===
    print("\n=== Phase 1: Probe + Val ===", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()

    ds_pv = load_dataset(
        "parquet",
        data_files={"train": [to_hf_url(f) for f in pv_files]},
        split="train",
        streaming=True,
    )

    probe_count = 0
    probe_total_tokens = 0
    val_count = 0
    val_total_tokens = 0

    probe_f = open(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "probe_set.jsonl"), "w")
    val_f = open(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "val_set.jsonl"), "w")

    for sample in ds_pv:
        text = sample.get("text", "")
        if not text or not text.strip():
            continue

        tokens = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
        n_tokens = len(tokens)

        if probe_count < PROBE_SIZE:
            if n_tokens >= PROBE_TOKEN_LEN:
                trunc = tokens[:PROBE_TOKEN_LEN]
                probe_f.write(json.dumps({
                    "text": tokenizer.decode(trunc),
                    "token_count": PROBE_TOKEN_LEN,
                }) + "\n")
                probe_count += 1
                probe_total_tokens += PROBE_TOKEN_LEN
                if probe_count % 1000 == 0:
                    print(f"  Probe: {probe_count}/{PROBE_SIZE}", flush=True)
            elif val_total_tokens < VAL_TARGET_TOKENS:
                val_f.write(json.dumps({"text": text}) + "\n")
                val_count += 1
                val_total_tokens += n_tokens
        elif val_total_tokens < VAL_TARGET_TOKENS:
            val_f.write(json.dumps({"text": text}) + "\n")
            val_count += 1
            val_total_tokens += n_tokens
            if val_count % 5000 == 0:
                print(f"  Val: {val_count} samples, {val_total_tokens / 1e6:.1f}M tokens", flush=True)
        else:
            break

    probe_f.close()
    val_f.close()

    t1 = time.time()
    print(f"Probe: {probe_count} samples, {probe_total_tokens:,} tokens", flush=True)
    print(f"Val: {val_count} samples, {val_total_tokens:,} tokens ({val_total_tokens / 1e6:.1f}M)", flush=True)
    print(f"Phase 1 time: {t1 - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)

    if probe_count < PROBE_SIZE:
        print(f"WARNING: Only got {probe_count}/{PROBE_SIZE} probe samples from {PV_COUNT} files", flush=True)
    if val_total_tokens < VAL_TARGET_TOKENS:
        print(f"WARNING: Only got {val_total_tokens/1e6:.1f}M/{VAL_TARGET_TOKENS/1e6:.0f}M val tokens", flush=True)

    # === Phase 2: Train pool ===
    print(f"\n=== Phase 2: Train pool (~400M tokens from {len(train_files)} files) ===", flush=True)

    train_count = 0
    train_total_tokens = 0
    BATCH = 10
    files_used = 0

    with open(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "real_pool.jsonl"), "w") as f:
        for bi in range(0, len(train_files), BATCH):
            if train_total_tokens >= TRAIN_TARGET_TOKENS:
                break

            batch = train_files[bi:bi + BATCH]
            files_used = bi + len(batch)
            print(f"  Loading batch {bi//BATCH + 1}: files {bi}-{bi + len(batch) - 1}...", flush=True)

            ds_t = load_dataset(
                "parquet",
                data_files={"train": [to_hf_url(bf) for bf in batch]},
                split="train",
                streaming=True,
            )

            for sample in ds_t:
                text = sample.get("text", "")
                if not text or not text.strip():
                    continue

                tokens = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
                n_tokens = len(tokens)

                f.write(json.dumps({"text": text}) + "\n")
                train_count += 1
                train_total_tokens += n_tokens

                if train_count % 10000 == 0:
                    elapsed = time.time() - t1
                    rate = train_total_tokens / elapsed if elapsed > 0 else 0
                    eta = (TRAIN_TARGET_TOKENS - train_total_tokens) / rate / 60 if rate > 0 else 0
                    print(f"  Train: {train_count} samples, {train_total_tokens / 1e6:.1f}M tokens "
                          f"({rate / 1e6:.1f}M tok/s, ETA {eta:.0f}min)", flush=True)

                if train_total_tokens >= TRAIN_TARGET_TOKENS:
                    break

    t2 = time.time()

    # === Summary ===
    print("\n" + "=" * 60, flush=True)
    print("SUMMARY", flush=True)
    print("=" * 60, flush=True)
    for name, cnt, tok in [
        ("probe_set", probe_count, probe_total_tokens),
        ("val_set", val_count, val_total_tokens),
        ("real_pool", train_count, train_total_tokens),
    ]:
        avg = tok / cnt if cnt > 0 else 0
        print(f"  {name:12s}: {cnt:>8,} samples, {tok:>13,} tokens (avg {avg:.0f} tok/sample)", flush=True)

    total_tok = probe_total_tokens + val_total_tokens + train_total_tokens
    total_cnt = probe_count + val_count + train_count
    print(f"  {'TOTAL':12s}: {total_cnt:>8,} samples, {total_tok:>13,} tokens", flush=True)
    print(f"\nTotal time: {t2 - t0:.0f}s ({(t2 - t0) / 60:.1f} min)", flush=True)
    print(f"No-overlap: probe+val from files [0:{PV_COUNT}], train from files [{PV_COUNT}:{files_used}]", flush=True)

    for fname in ["probe_set.jsonl", "val_set.jsonl", "real_pool.jsonl"]:
        fpath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, fname)
        if os.path.exists(fpath):
            size_mb = os.path.getsize(fpath) / 1e6
            print(f"  {fname}: {size_mb:.1f} MB", flush=True)

    print("\nDONE", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
SCRIPT_EOF
